title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 57. takes note of the ongoing work on a European qualifications label; recalls that, in accordance with Article 165 TFEU, Member States remain responsible for the content and organisation of their education systems; supports mutual recognition of qualifications and voluntary cross-border cooperation; stresses that any future European degree must remain voluntary and must neither replace national degrees nor lead to the harmonisation of national higher education systems;
